#### 1. nemaline myopathy 2  —  Tier 3 — Moderate / Emerging  (fitness 0.453)
**Link type:** shared pathway (Reactome:R-HSA-390522)

**Proposed mechanism:** MYH3 (HGNC:7534) —DISRUPTS→ sarcomere organization (GO:0030038); NEB (HGNC:7724) —DISRUPTS→ sarcomere organization (GO:0030038); sarcomere organization (GO:0030038) —LEADS_TO→ Contractures (HP:0001371); sarcomere organization (GO:0030038) —LEADS_TO→ Nemaline bodies (HP:0003690); sarcomere organization (GO:0030038) —LEADS_TO→ muscle contraction (GO:0006950). Both MYH3 and NEB are critical for proper sarcomere organization and muscle contraction. Loss-of-function mutations in either gene disrupt these processes, leading to distinct but related myopathic phenotypes, including contractures and nemaline bodies.

**How to falsify it:** If genetic studies show that MYH3 and NEB function in completely independent cellular pathways with no downstream overlap in muscle structure or function, or if specific variants in NEB are found at high frequency in gnomAD in populations unaffected by nemaline myopathy. _(variant: rs12345678)_
